entries.title: Psalms 109:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, do not be silent;

entries.title: Psalms 109:2
segments: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me; they spoke against me [with] a lying tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 109:3
segments: And they surrounded me [with] words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 109:4
segments: For my love they are my foes; but I [am in] prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 109:5
segments: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

entries.title: Psalms 109:6
segments: Set a wicked man over him; and let an adversary stand at his right hand,

entries.title: Psalms 109:7
segments: when he is judged, let him be condemned; and let his prayer become sin.

entries.title: Psalms 109:8
segments: Let his days be few; let another take his office.

entries.title: Psalms 109:9
segments: Let his sons be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

entries.title: Psalms 109:10
segments: Let his sons always beg and be vagabonds, and seek [food] out of their ruins.

entries.title: Psalms 109:11
segments: Let the money-lender lay a snare for all that [is] his; and let strangers take the fruit of his labor.

entries.title: Psalms 109:12
segments: Let there be none to give mercy to him; nor [any] to favor his fatherless children.

entries.title: Psalms 109:13
segments: Let his posterity be cut off; [and] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:14
segments: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered to the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:15
segments: Let them be always before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 109:16
segments: because he did not remember to do mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, and sought to kill the broken-hearted.

entries.title: Psalms 109:17
segments: Yea, he loved cursing, so let it come to him; he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:18
segments: As he clothed himself with cursing, as with his robe, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

entries.title: Psalms 109:19
segments: Let it be to him as the robe [which] covers him, and for a girdle with which he is always clothed.

entries.title: Psalms 109:20
segments: This [is] the reward of my foes from the LORD, and [of] them who speak evil against my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 109:21
segments: But You, Lord Jehovah, deal kindly with me for Your name's sake; because Your mercy [is] good, deliver me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:22
segments: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:23
segments: As a shadow when it is stretched out, I am gone; I am shaken off like the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 109:24
segments: My knees stumble from fasting; and my flesh is losing its fatness.

entries.title: Psalms 109:25
segments: And I became a shame to them; they looked on me; they shook their heads.

entries.title: Psalms 109:26
segments: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your mercy;

entries.title: Psalms 109:27
segments: and they will know that this [is] Your hand; that You, LORD, have done it.

entries.title: Psalms 109:28
segments: They will curse, but You will bless; they arise, and are ashamed; but let Your servant rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 109:29
segments: Let my foes be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own shame, as with a cloak.

entries.title: Psalms 109:30
segments: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise Him among the multitude.

entries.title: Psalms 109:31
segments: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those who condemn his soul.
